title: Discounts & Promos
subtitle: Put a percentage off many items at once for a sale period. List prices never change, so ending a promo restores them exactly.

dated.title: Dated discounts
dated.subtitle: Discounts that switch on by themselves on the dates you choose and off again afterwards, then come round on the same dates every year until you delete them. They never change an item's own discount: on the day, the bigger of the two applies.
dated.empty: No dated discounts yet. Create one for a day or a few days you already know about.

stages.soon: Coming up in the next 14 days ({count})

dated.startsIn: {count, plural, =0 {Starts today} one {Starts tomorrow} other {Starts in # days}}
dated.skipped: “{name}” won't run in {year}. It comes round again the year after.
dated.deleteDescription: It stops applying straight away and won't come round again. Items keep their own discounts. This can't be undone.

form.description: On these dates the items are sold at this discount, then go back to what they had before. It repeats on the same dates every year.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: For you, to recognise it next year.
form.datesHint: Leave the second date empty for a single day. To move it for a coming year, change the dates here.
